text: Philippines, 2011. Two little girls stepped into the street. A motorcycle was coming fast. Kabang, the family's dog, *threw herself in front of it.* The girls were safe. Kabang *lost her snout and upper jaw.* People around the world raised money, and vets in California treated her. She came home to a hero's welcome and *lived to 13.* Send this to a dog lover.
title: The Dog Who Gave Her Face for Two Girls 🐕❤️
alt_titles: The Dog Who Stopped a Motorcycle 🐕✨
